# QR decoder

`html5-qrcode.min.js` is the unmodified browser bundle from **html5-qrcode 2.3.8**:
https://registry.npmjs.org/html5-qrcode/-/html5-qrcode-2.3.8.tgz

Upstream: https://github.com/mebjas/html5-qrcode
License: Apache-2.0 (see `html5-qrcode.LICENSE`).

Serve this pinned file from the same origin so scanning does not depend on an
external CDN. The npm archive contains the bundle at its root, not `dist/`.
